title.cn: 平安金融中心：登高看电路板城市
title.en: Ping An Tower: City as Circuit Board

text.cn: 登高要购票/预约。脚下的城市网格像一块巨大电路板——华强北的亲戚在发光。电梯里有人认真补口红，有人认真回工作消息。
text.en: Deck needs ticket/booking. The grid below looks like a giant PCB — Huaqiangbei’s glowing relatives. In the lift: lipstick repair and Slack replies, equally serious.

feedback.cn: 高度让焦虑变小。你暂时觉得自己也「很湾区」。
feedback.en: Altitude shrinks anxiety. You briefly feel very “Greater Bay”.

text.cn: 下班高峰挤电梯：垂直早高峰。

feedback.cn: 你看见了风景，也看见了别人的肩膀。登高，原来也要排队。
feedback.en: You see the view and many shoulders. Even height requires queues.

text.cn: 票售罄，只能仰望：免费的颈椎运动。
text.en: Sold out; look up: free neck exercise.

feedback.cn: 大厦还在。你的预约技巧也需要升级。
feedback.en: Tower remains. Your booking skills need a firmware update.

text.cn: 登高日结束。云还在上面，你回到地面继续扫码。
text.en: Deck day ends. Clouds stay up; you return to QR life below.
